elaine (partnerships): Heads up — VectorCloud POC kickoff with MegaRetail tomorrow at 10am PT. Need a quick tech handoff and pricing/entitlements checklist. @kevin can you join the call? :wave:

jordan (solutions): Yep, I'll join. What's the ask from MegaRetail?

elaine (partnerships): They want a joint demo of our Dedicated+Private flow: model-serving on partner infra, Redwood control plane for routing/metrics. 3-week eval, ~10k requests/day. Also they asked about data residency and KMS integration.

aj (sales): Pricing question — are we doing a timeboxed POC rate or usage credit? They prefer a predictable commit for procurement.

jordan (solutions): For predictability we usually offer a month-limited reserved capacity at reduced rate. For 3 weeks we can do a pro-rated reserved commit + overage at hosted rates. I'll draft numbers after we confirm GPU type and qps.

kevin (partner-eng): FYI VectorCloud can spin up a private VPC with 2x A100-equivalent nodes. Need to confirm model size (7B vs 70B) and batching target. 10k req/day with 95th latency goal 200ms suggests smaller model or aggressive quant.

elaine (partnerships): Good point. MegaRetail wants the conversational workflow (multi-turn) with embeddings for search. Likely 7B family to start.

sam (security): Quick checklist from security side: SOC2 attestation on partner infra, KMS key wrapping (customer-managed), and export controls. Also need answers for the questionnaire items: data retention policy, access controls, audit logs. I'll paste the docs they expect.

sam (security): ```
- SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months)
- KMS support with CMK import/export options
- VPC peering + private Egress options
- Audit log retention 90d (can be extended)
```

kevin (partner-eng): VectorCloud already has SOC2 and KMS, but need to confirm CMK import. I'll ask them and loop back.

aj (sales): Procurement will also ask for a short SLA for the POC. Can we commit to 99% uptime for the window?

jordan (solutions): For POC windows we usually offer best-effort with uptime objective but not full enterprise SLA. We can offer 99% best-effort if VectorCloud agrees to reserved capacity. Put it in writing in the statement of work.

elaine (partnerships): Action items so far:
- kevin: confirm CMK import + SOC2 snapshot from VectorCloud (today)
- jordan: cost estimate and reserve proposal for 3-week POC (by EOD)
- sam: prepare answers for the RFP questionnaire and redlines for data residency (tomorrow)
- aj: schedule procurement intro + SOW template (today)

kevin (partner-eng): On the architecture/ops side, recommend we use this routing pattern: Redwood control plane -> partner private pool (primary) -> fallback hosted variant (read-only) if capacity drops. Example policy snippet:```
route:
  - priority: PRIMARY
    target: partner:vectorcloud:pool-a
  - priority: FALLBACK
    target: redwood:shared:low-cost
    conditions: [capacity_constrained]
```

jordan (solutions): That fallback is perfect for reliability. Also suggest enabling prefix KV caching for the multi-turn conv to reduce token cost. I'll include expected token estimates.

aj (sales): Can we include an explicit switch to force hosted-only during the demo? Partner might want to avoid any provisioning delays.

kevin (partner-eng): Yes. We can pre-provision pool-a and a small hosted dev pool for demos. We'll put a runbook for failover in the prep doc.

sam (security): One more: MegaRetail requires that logs with PII are redacted before leaving partner network. Is there a built-in redact hook?

jordan (solutions): We have a pre-processing webhook that can mask fields. Example payload rule: `redact(fields:["email","ssn","credit_card"])`. We'll include that in the config.

elaine (partnerships): Great. Can everyone be on the call at 9:50am PT tomorrow for a 10am start? I'll share the dial-in + agenda.

kevin (partner-eng): Confirmed. I'll bring the VectorCloud eng lead.

jordan (solutions): Confirmed. I'll bring the runbook + cost slides.

aj (sales): Confirmed. I'll bring procurement.

sam (security): Can do 10-15 min at the start for security Qs.

sre-bot: Deploy job #4167: reserved-poc-pool creation started for partner vectorcloud (logs at https://ci.redwood.ai/4167) :construction:

elaine (partnerships): Perfect — I'll post the pre-read (SOW draft, architecture diagram, and security checklist) now. Please review before the call. :eyes:
